meta_description: Cheshire Plastering & Pointing in Manchester delivers expert plastering, rendering and pointing work. Quality finishes, reliable service. Call 07496 119817.
hero_subhead: From skimming and rendering to decorative finishes, we transform your walls. Stockport-based team with years of experience.
services_heading: Complete Plastering Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: Whether you need interior finishing, external rendering, or specialist pointing work, we deliver professional results on time and to budget.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Smooth, flawless finishes for walls and ceilings. We prepare, plaster and skim to create the perfect surface for decoration.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant render coatings that protect and enhance your property. Hardwearing finishes designed to last decades.

services.title: Lime Pointing & Repointing
services.desc: Specialist brick and stone pointing using traditional lime mortar. Breathable and sympathetic to period properties.

services.title: Textured & Decorative Finishes
services.desc: Artex removal, polished plaster, and bespoke finishes. Transform spaces with professional decorative plastering.

services.title: Damp & Crack Repair
services.desc: Identify and repair moisture damage and structural cracks. We assess the root cause and apply lasting solutions.

services.title: New Build & Extensions
services.desc: Full plastering for new build homes and extensions. On-schedule completion with immaculate finishes ready for handover.

about_pullquote: Honest work, done right first time—that's how we've built our reputation.
about_para_1: Cheshire Plastering & Pointing has been serving Manchester and Stockport homeowners for over 15 years. We've grown from a small family operation into a trusted team, handling everything from listed property restoration to new-build commercial contracts. Every member of our crew is time-served and takes pride in the quality of their finish.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our attention to detail and straightforward approach. We turn up on time, work clean, and communicate clearly throughout the job. Our customers come back because we listen to what they want and deliver exactly that—no shortcuts, no surprises on the invoice.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the whole front of the house rendered and the garage repointed. The lads were tidy, professional and knew exactly what they were doing. Finished on time and the work looks pristine. Couldn't ask for better. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Called them on a Friday about damp patches on my bedroom wall. They came out Saturday morning, sorted the root cause and replastered it beautifully. Fair price, no nonsense, job done properly. Will use them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Needed the interior redecorated after water damage. They skimmed all the walls and ceilings, filled cracks, and left everything smooth and perfect. The finishing touch made such a difference. Great team to work with.
reviews.author: Richard T.
